title: Stronghold Finder (One Eye Updated)
description: One Eye fortress finder updated for 26.2. Saves alot of time working out the maths on servers and personally I find it far to useful
body:
## **One eye stronghold finder**
A client-side fabric mod which allows you to find stronghold with only one Eye of Ender.

## **Instructions**
Just throw Eye of Ender and mod will write the coordinates of nearest stronghold in the chat.
Green coordinates mean that the structure is most likely located here. The accuracy that the first coordinates will be a stronghold is 95%.

![preview](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1e0b2afb-9917-4131-83bc-c7aefae849a4)

## **How it works**
The mod takes the initial and final coordinates of the eye, draws a ray, calculates the nearest intersections with the corners of the chunks and outputs the found data to the chat. Like Ninjabrain Bot, but ingame and less accurate.

Updated from https://modrinth.com/mod/one-eye-stronghold-finder to 26.2
